title: KISIK, AI-based prediction and optimization methods in assistance systems for the effective and efficient management of intensive care capacity in German hospitals: Which model is superior in predicting Length of Stay and Mortality: Decision-making with artificial intelligence vs. clinical decision-making at the bedside
summary: As part of the project, an AI tool was developed to predict the expected length of stay of patients in the intensive care unit 24 hours after admission. This prediction is provided to the resident physicians to support their own assessment. The accuracy of these predictions is then compared with the forecasts made by senior physicians.

interventions.name: Senior physicians estimate the patients’ length of stay in the ICU based on their clinical experience.
Resident physicians estimate the patients’ length of stay in the ICU based on their clinical experience and with the support of an AI tool.
